label: early copy phase: first two copy steps after <DEL> (recall_idx 1-2)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99% of mass), mostly on the first copy step after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, input = orig(0); 60% of mass, rate 45%) and the second (recall_idx 2; 32% of mass), then dies off quickly from recall_idx 3 (6%) onward. Essentially silent in the original phase and on the <DEL> step itself. Within these steps it fires on only about 36% of instances, and the strongest activations depend on the tokens: largest when the sequence starts with p or m and is followed by z (e.g. p z ... reaches the max at the first copy step), and outputs like z, l, x, 3 have elevated rates. Simple token-set conditions did not improve F1 though, so the token dependence is not captured. Rate is higher for long sequences with many outputs left (to_go >= 3), and lower for L = 3-4. Predicate gets mass recall 0.92 but precision is only about 0.36.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: z, l, x, c, 3, o; least: p, k, d, u) and the current input token, by step (t=17: p, k, j, q; t=15: p, m, 1, t; t=16: p, t, k, m); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=1, recall_idx=2, t=3.
